title: World Knowledge Quiz
description: Challenge your understanding of international diplomacy, global inventions, languages, and world geography.
seoTitle: World Knowledge Quiz – International Trivia | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: Test your global awareness with this 10-question World Knowledge Quiz. Learn interesting facts with detailed explanations.

questions.question: Where is the official headquarters of the United Nations located?
questions.explanation: The primary headquarters of the United Nations is in the Turtle Bay neighborhood of Manhattan, New York City.

questions.question: Which language has the highest number of native speakers worldwide?
questions.explanation: Mandarin Chinese has the largest number of first-language (native) speakers in the world, with over 900 million native speakers.

questions.question: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded annually in which city?
questions.explanation: Unlike the other Nobel Prizes which are presented in Stockholm, Sweden, the Nobel Peace Prize is presented annually in Oslo, Norway.

questions.question: Which canal connects the Mediterranean Sea directly to the Red Sea?
questions.explanation: The Suez Canal in Egypt is an artificial sea-level waterway that provides the shortest maritime route between Europe and Asia.

questions.question: Which ancient civilization constructed the cliff-top citadel of Machu Picchu?
questions.explanation: Machu Picchu was built by the Inca Empire in the 15th century high in the Andes mountains of Peru.

questions.question: What is the longest river in the world by conventional consensus?
questions.explanation: The Nile River in northeastern Africa is traditionally recognized as the longest river at approximately 6,650 km (4,132 miles).

questions.question: Which country is famously known as the 'Land of the Midnight Sun'?
questions.explanation: Norway is called the Land of the Midnight Sun because parts of it experience 24-hour sunlight during summer months north of the Arctic Circle.

questions.question: In which century did the Renaissance period begin?
questions.explanation: The Renaissance began in Florence, Italy, during the 14th century (circa 1300s) before spreading across Europe.

questions.question: What is the name of the world's highest uninterrupted waterfall?
questions.explanation: Angel Falls in Canaima National Park, Venezuela, is the world's highest uninterrupted waterfall, dropping 979 meters (3,212 feet).

questions.question: Which is the smallest recognized independent nation in the world by both area and population?
questions.explanation: Vatican City covers an area of roughly 49 hectares (121 acres) entirely enclosed within Rome, Italy.
